LanguageData.FB_FleshBulwark.label: flesh bulwark
LanguageData.FB_FleshBulwark.description: A hardened knot of defensive tissue. It does not extract hemogel, but the surrounding covered tiles grow thick armoured plating that turns aside outside raids.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTreeNursery.label: flesh tree and leaf nursery
LanguageData.FB_FleshTreeNursery.description: An abstract planetary growth site that accelerates hemogel extraction from its covered world tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshRiverSiphon.label: great river siphon
LanguageData.FB_FleshRiverSiphon.description: An abstract planetary organ that drinks from rivers, lakes or nearby coasts and greatly accelerates hemogel extraction from its covered world tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCamp.label: flesh ambush camp
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCamp.description: An abstract planetary trap-camp that harvests hemogel from its covered tile and stores occasional loot taken from animals and passing caravans.
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorer.label: crust corer
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorer.description: An abstract planetary drilling organ. It grinds the biomass of its covered tile into mined ore, exhausting that tile far faster than passive extraction and yielding less as the tile dies. Hills and mountains push its output towards rarer ores.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelNexus.label: tunnel nexus
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelNexus.description: An abstract planetary organ that grows a second flesh tunnel maw on a distant world tile. Caravans standing on either maw can be swallowed and spat out at the other end far faster than they could walk, and flesh war parties reroute through the tunnel whenever it saves them time. Collapsing the tunnel leaves the nexus itself intact.
